name: Elder Skyseer
summary: At Freewind Post, Elder Skyseer watches over travelers as an ancestor beyond the mortal world. His spirit remains tied to the resting grounds of his people.

sections.title: A Spirit of Freewind Post
sections.body: High above Thousand Needles, Elder Skyseer watches over Freewind Post from its mesa. Tauren cross perilous bridges and wooden platforms there, while he keeps watch beyond the mortal veil. Travelers who honor old traditions may receive his blessings and seek the wisdom of past generations.

sections.title: Ties to the Ancestral Lands
sections.body: Elder Skyseer’s spirit often appears among the wind-carved needles. He belongs to the line of tauren ancestors honored on Mulgore’s sacred soil, where the ancestral spirits of Red Rocks watch over the tribes. Through remembrance and ritual, those ancestors guide future generations. His presence shows how thin the veil remains between the living and the dead.

faq.answer: Elder Skyseer watches over Freewind Post in Thousand Needles as an ancestral tauren spirit. He offers guidance to travelers who seek him.

faq.q: Why is Elder Skyseer a ghost?
faq.answer: Elder Skyseer passed from the mortal world and remains as an ancient ancestor. Tauren honor their forebears, and certain elders linger or return in spirit to guide the living.

faq.q: What is his connection to Mulgore?
faq.answer: Elder Skyseer belongs to the tauren people, whose homeland is Mulgore. There, the ancestral spirits of Red Rocks watch over the tribes. His spirit appears at Freewind Post in Thousand Needles.

faq.q: Where can I find Elder Skyseer?
faq.answer: Elder Skyseer watches over Freewind Post in Thousand Needles, atop its mesa settlement high above the canyon floor.

angles.text: As a tauren, meeting Elder Skyseer brings you into communion with an ancestor. His presence reflects the reverence taught at Red Rocks and across Mulgore’s plains.
As a shaman, you speak with the elements and spirits. You recognize the wisdom of ancestors who continue to watch over the living.
